en.headline: Driver arrested after light goods vehicle hits 92-year-old woman in Chai Wan
en.dek: Police charged a 35-year-old man with dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm after the vehicle struck a pedestrian near Fung Wah Estate on Friday morning.
body: A 92-year-old woman was seriously injured when a light goods vehicle struck her on a pedestrian crossing in Chai Wan on Friday morning.

Police said the incident occurred at about 11.14am on Fung Ha Road near the junction with Fei Tsui Road, outside Fung Wah Estate. The woman, surnamed Yung, was knocked several metres and suffered head and limb injuries. She was found unconscious and taken to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital for treatment.

Officers arrested a 35-year-old local man, surnamed Cheung, on suspicion of dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm. The vehicle’s left side mirror was damaged and parcels from the van were unloaded before it was towed away for examination. Police are continuing inquiries.

zh.headline: 柴灣客貨車撞倒92歲老婦 司機涉危駕致他人身體嚴重受傷被捕
zh.dek: 警方指今早11時許峰霞道近翡翠道交界發生意外，35歲本地男司機涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人身體嚴重受傷被捕。
body: 柴灣今早發生交通意外，一名92歲老婦被客貨車撞倒後昏迷送院。
警方表示，上午約11時14分，一部客貨車沿峰霞道落斜駛至翡翠道路口前行人過路處，左車頭撞倒正在過路的翁姓婆婆，她被撞飛約兩米倒地，頭部及手腳受傷，地上遺下血跡，昏迷被送往東區尤德夫人那打素醫院搶救。
警方其後以涉嫌「危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害」拘捕35歲蔣姓本地男司機，現正扣留調查。涉事客貨車左後鏡損毀，車上快遞貨件需搬出，車輛已被拖走驗車。
